events.verdict: Okoro (CHI) and Edgecombe (PHI) engage and disengage during the rebound.
Maxey (PHI) lowers his arms and blocks Buzelis's (CHI) shot attempt at the rim. Any arm contact after the blocked shot is incidental.
Vucevic (CHI) contests Maxey's (PHI) driving shot attempt, and the contact after the release is marginal.
Buzelis (CHI) clamps and holds Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Grimes (PHI) maintains an arm against Buzelis's (CHI) back without extending it during the reboubd.
Buzelis (CHI) directly contests Maxey's (PHI) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Maxey's (PHI) hand after the release.
Grimes (PHI) contests Vucevic's (CHI) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with his arm does not prevent him from following through.
Embiid (PHI) has his arms slightly extended as Buzelis (CHI) defends under the screen, but the contact is marginal.
Buzelis (CHI) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Grimes' (PHI) arm.
